user_request: Compare replacement-EPC and owner-prime completion options from an itemized unpaid ledger and remaining-scope quotes. Reconcile gross budget headroom separately from cash funding; exclude disputed recoveries. Challenge scope and asset readiness before reporting conditional savings.

role_mandates.evidence_contract: Validate synthetic classification, reviewed source, disjoint scope coverage, payments and service inputs. Produce an input-hashed ledger and physical screen. Do not invent invoices, tests or approvals.
role_mandates.project_finance_analyst: Recompute the evidence handoff; compare forward costs, gross forecast-at-completion, peak funding before monthly receipts, horizon-end funding and price crossover. Retain adverse and non-comparable scenarios.
role_mandates.energy_orchestrator: Delegate only registered ready evidence and finance tasks. No purchases, contract execution or external communication.

input_schema: case.json v1; finite nonboolean CAD amounts, 1..36 integer horizon, ISO as_of >= source access; exactly replacement_epc and owner_prime, unique package IDs disjoint from unpaid IDs; each required work scope exactly once per plan; nonnegative payment fractions summing to one, unique months within horizon; completion within horizon, all payments by completion; common unpaid rows paid within horizon. Receipts: grant/assumed_conditional or recovery/disputed only, lag >=0. Unique named scenarios, owner quote uplift [-1,3], capacity fraction [0,1], delay 0..36 months. Positive target, duration and capacity; SOC 0<=reserve<initial<=1; efficiency (0,1]. Explicit limitations and gaps. All inputs are synthetic, not actual quotes or tests.
evidence_requirements: Preserve event versus publication/access dates and original URL.
Original contract value cannot substitute for paid plus outstanding costs.
Do not net grants or disputed damages against gross construction budget; do not claim source funding figures reconcile.
Require actual scope/invoices/quotes, grant evidence and OEM/engineering acceptance before decisions.
handoffs: Input-hashed scope/payment/service audit -> existing finance role; exact recomputation rejects stale or changed handoffs.
Finance report -> human procurement/technical review, no automatic action.
output_contract: Per plan/scenario: quote and unpaid cost, forecast gross completion cost, headroom, monthly cash ledger, peak and terminal funding, funding shortfall.
Service MW/MWh and physical comparison validity. Conditional forward-cost reduction is null on failed service screen.
Owner quote uplift crossover, ignored disputed receipt amount, beyond-horizon receipts and evidence gaps.
Baseline is direct deterministic arithmetic; scripted workflow parity. No LLM execution or benefit claim, tokens/cost/latency unknown.
acceptance: No omitted or double-counted scope, duplicate payments or costs.
Sunk costs cancel in forward savings but remain in gross budget.
Late or disputed receipts cannot improve peak cash before they are available.
Zero, boundary, adverse quote, capacity failure, stale handoff and forbidden-action tests pass.
